answer.says: The steam is the universal heat rising from the particular pot; I shall partake of the universal, as the Phenomenology dictates. One cup of masala chai, please.
answer.thought: Sunil offers the steam as a commodity, indifferent to its metaphysical status. I accept the universal heat in its particular form, for the spirit must eat to continue its dialectic. The body's demand is the immediate truth that precedes all abstraction.
